subject: design/e2e-verification-skills-v2
statement: e2e-design reads the feature's **PRD requirement rows** (the coverage backbone), its **live technical-design set**, and the **built code**, and authors the `e2e-design/v2` doc. It **refuses and produces nothing** if any input is absent — no PRD or live design → refuse naming the input (`prd:e2e-verification/UB-2`); not-yet-implemented → refuse naming the unlanded work (`UB-1`) — and it **produces nothing and signals the operator to stop the pipeline** when the feature has no meaningfully-automatable e2e surface (`UB-7`).
